about: Exceptions to the A5 wording rules (evals/wording/linter.ts). Only official names, direct quotes, acronyms readers already know, files that reproduce someone else's words, and real public figures belong here. Everything else the linter finds is a real finding under the owner's wording rules. Add an entry only with its reason; never to make a count go down.

knownAcronyms.DHS: Every page header shows the Minnesota Department of Human Services name with its logo (components/site-header.tsx).
knownAcronyms.DSD: Every page header shows the Disability Services Division label (components/site-header.tsx).
knownAcronyms.PDF: File format readers know by its acronym; download buttons name the format.
knownAcronyms.CSV: File format named on download controls.
knownAcronyms.HTML: File format named on download controls.
knownAcronyms.COVID: Disease name as people say it (COVID-19).

quotedSourceFiles.lib/content/state-pages.json: Text copied from public State of Minnesota agency pages for search and Ask; the publisher's words, kept as published.
